== Notes ==
* Because this is not a spell, this will not count toward the 10-spell limit on [[Glyph of Elemental Power]] or {{gr|1|3}}-spell limit on [[Glyph of Energy]], but will still get the stat boost.
* Frequently used by melee characters, especially warrior and assassin, to meet the knocked-down target requirement of certain skills. The touch range is not an issue.
**Warriors can extend the knockdown by 1 second using a [[Stonefist Insignia]].
**Warriors relying on [[Adrenaline]] will not mind the overcast toll.
**The knockdown will occur at Air Magic 0.
**Can be used while [[blinded]] or affected by [[anti-melee]] hexes such as [[Ineptitude]]. Additionally, it cannot be [[blocked]].
